title: Roasted Chestnut Salad
description: A hearty, vegan salad featuring roasted chestnuts and a variety of greens.
instructions: Wrap chestnuts in foil and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
While chestnuts are roasting, prepare the vinaigrette by whisking together light vinaigrette, apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, and garlic powder in a small bowl.
In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, roasted chestnuts, and salad.
Drizzle the vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle crushed french baguette and smoked salt over the top of the salad.
Note: Allow the salad to sit at room temperature for 10-15 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
